title.en: Amending Executive Order No. 537 Dated May 24, 1979 Creating the Garments and Textile Export Board
title.orig: Amending Executive Order No. 537 Dated May 24, 1979 Creating the Garments and Textile Export Board

text.en:
The Garments and Textile Export Board created under Executive Order No. 537 shall be composed of
three members, the Minister of Trade and Industry or his representative as Chairman, the Chairman of the
Embroidery and Apparel Control and Inspection Board or his representative and the Commissioner of the
Bureau of Customs or his representative, as Members.

All laws, decrees, orders, proclamations, rules, regulations or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with
any of the provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
